content.summary: 'Animal Jumps' develops mathematical reasoning and application through the chapter 'Animal Jumps'. The main learning is organised around the source-supported points below.
key_points: Numbers put in this box get multiplied by a number and come out.
(a) Can you guess the multiplier if you see the 4 numbers coming out of the box?
(b) Is there more than one possible multiplier?
(c) What numbers might have been put inside the box?
You can also play this game with your friends.
The multipliers 1, 2, and 4 that you found above are the factors of the numbers that have come out of the box, that is, 28, 36, 48, and 72.
